_note: Episode 20 (S2E12, season finale) keyframes. Present-day Mactan (no dog: Usman exists only in the jump light and in the past; the jump light at the marker is where he faces Tubal) and dawn of 27 April 1521 seen from the mangroves. Real people (Lapulapu, Magellan, Humabon, the warriors, Pigafetta) are generic figures from behind or far, never likenesses, no blood; Lapulapu's diwa is light only; the present-day statue is drawn generically. Siyokoy are folklore guardians, never killed; the weapons wound no one. Tobias Alcain (Tubal) and Rico Bulan are fiction. Copied: full intro, sandugo_seal, notebook_glow (Episode 11); usman_return (Episode 10). Shots follow sentences.json; k80-k89 are montage extras.
